create_TranscriptBuffer: create a TranscriptBuffer with a flush callback and timeout to buffer transcript fragments
append_TranscriptBuffer: append text fragments to a TranscriptBuffer that auto flushes after a timeout period
flush_TranscriptBuffer: flush a TranscriptBuffer to immediately send all buffered text to the callback
clear_TranscriptBuffer: clear a TranscriptBuffer without flushing to discard all buffered text fragments
handle_event: handle an event_bus Event by printing it to the terminal with color-coded formatting
